info.title: RoomCircuit
info.author: LANywhere contributors
info.description: Switch Local Wireless over the internet
info.details: RoomCircuit (formerly LANywhere Self-host) brings Switch Local Wireless online with room browsing, node tests, and scheduling. Requires Atmosphère. Shares the ldn_mitm module ID. Install one and restart Atmosphère.\n\nAI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: description text.

changelog: Fixes SD card preparation during in-app updates.
